why: This is a synchronized audio-and-visual presentation, so it is a specific multilingual implementation of Multimedia Learning rather than a distinct instructional element.
This is an inductive scoping-review framework for organising literature and implementation issues around GTA programmes, not a general explanatory theory of learning or a named adoptable programme.
This is an education-specific framework for measuring and evaluating GTA professional-development effects and their contextual moderators, not a general theory of learning.
name: Conceptual framework for GTA professional development research and evaluation
